Search checked and live ArcGIS datasets

Source: R/api-discovery.R
tbod_search_datasets.Rd

Searches checked Tampa Bay entries and, when requested, configured live ArcGIS portals. The checked catalog is a selected, offline registry; live discovery searches each publisher's public portal index. Use tbod_discover() to search another ArcGIS portal or a service URL.

Usage

tbod_search_datasets(
  query,
  jurisdiction = "all",
  source = "all",
  portals = "all",
  max_items = 25,
  timeout = 30,
  total_timeout = 90,
  publisher = NULL,
  validation_status = NULL,
  spatial = NULL,
  topic = NULL,
  category = NULL,
  modified_after = NULL,
  modified_before = NULL,
  limit = Inf
)

Arguments

query

A single search string. Checked matching treats punctuation literally and ignores case; its separate words must all match. Live matching uses the ArcGIS portal index. An empty or whitespace-only query lists datasets.

jurisdiction

Jurisdiction code or vector of codes from tbod_list_portals(), or "all" (default). Filters checked and live results and narrows the portal scan.

source

"all" (default) combines live discovery with checked entries; "live" returns portal layers with checked matches marked; "checked" reads only the offline registry.

portals

Configured publisher IDs from tbod_list_portals(), or "all". This selects live portals and does not filter checked entries.

max_items

Maximum number of service items scanned per selected portal. Defaults to 25; Inf follows all search pages. An item can expand to multiple layers, so this does not bound the row count.

timeout

Per-request timeout in seconds.

total_timeout

Overall operation budget, including retries and live discovery. Defaults to 90 seconds; Inf disables the deadline.

publisher

Publisher name or vector, matched exactly without regard to case. Narrows both checked results and the live portal scan.

validation_status

"checked", "discovered", or a vector of both; NULL includes both. source = "live" can include checked matches.

spatial

TRUE selects layers with declared geometry, FALSE selects nonspatial tables, and NULL includes both and unknown geometry.

topic

Word or vector matched as case-insensitive literal substrings in tags and categories; NULL disables the filter.

category

Category or vector matched, ignoring case, against full source paths or their final labels.

modified_after, modified_before

Inclusive modification bounds. A Date or YYYY-MM-DD string includes its full UTC day; POSIXct specifies an instant. Unknown modification times are excluded when a bound is set. This is an item or checked snapshot time, not record freshness.

limit

Maximum result rows returned after filtering and ranking. Defaults to Inf; use a nonnegative whole number, including 0, or Inf. This does not cap the number of live service items scanned; see max_items.

Value

A tibble with the same columns and live discovery attributes as tbod_list_datasets(). A checked-only search requires no network request.

Details

Values within a filter are combined with OR; different filters and the search query are combined with AND. Publisher names are exact, case-insensitive filters; use tbod_list_portals() to inspect them. A publisher with no match returns no rows.

Checked entries search ID, title, description, publisher, category, and tags. Exact title or ID matches rank first, then title or ID prefixes, substrings, and matches across title or ID words. Tags, categories, and publisher matches follow; description-only matches rank after those. Within a rank, each word scores title, ID, tags or categories, publisher, and description in that order; title, ID, and source URL then break ties consistently. If no checked entry matches the literal query, a spelling fallback may return close checked entries. Query words must be alphanumeric, and words shorter than four characters have no typo tolerance. The fallback does not change live portal search terms.

Live items come from the portal index, which can search fields not exposed in returned rows. Available row metadata helps rank them, but an indexed hit is retained even without a local text match. Layers found both live and in the checked catalog appear once with "checked" status. With source = "all", checked matches remain available even when a portal does not return them. limit applies after discovery, overlay, filtering, and ranking. Even limit = 0 still performs the selected live scan and preserves its diagnostics.

Portal searches include public Feature Service and Map Service items and expand supported, queryable layers. A private, unindexed, stale, or unavailable item may be absent. max_items caps service items per portal; item errors and capped scans can leave returned results incomplete, and a timeout can stop the operation. Check attr(result, "discovery_complete") and the issue, failed-portal, scanned-item, and truncated-portal attributes described in tbod_list_datasets(). Even a complete scan covers the public portal index, not every publisher service.

Examples

tbod_search_datasets("permit", source = "checked")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 23
#>   id             title description jurisdiction publisher source_url service_url
#>   <chr>          <chr> <chr>       <chr>        <chr>     <chr>      <chr>      
#> 1 construction-… Perm… Permit loc… tampa        City of … https://a… https://ar…
#> # ℹ 16 more variables: geometry_type <chr>, category <chr>, verified <date>,
#> #   terms <chr>, layer_id <int>, date_fields <list>, tags <list>,
#> #   item_id <chr>, portal <chr>, validation_status <chr>, modified <dttm>,
#> #   modified_source <chr>, service_type <chr>, layer_type <chr>,
#> #   categories <list>, original_metadata <list>
